baselines.exp6_factorial.csv: S=medium, n=20, L in {256,1024} - the short-L anchor; ZERO new baseline runs

comparison: M_A vs M_B (does L add predictive power?) vs M_C (does L x D add more?), evaluated on fresh 12B cells using log-loss/Brier + Spearman - spec identical to 12A.

stats.meanAtL(D): mean acc over D in {4,8} at length L

decision_rule.threshold_justification: UNCHANGED from 12A's frozen rule. 12A set these before seeing its own data; 12B tests them on FRESH n=20 samples (SE ~0.10/cell, ~0.05/aggregate), so a Stage-B pass here is the genuine confirmation 12A could only screen for.

extends: phase12a_protocol.json (thresholds + model spec COPIED UNCHANGED; only n and seed range differ)
honesty: 'Confirmed' = UNCHANGED Stage-B rule passes on FRESH n=20 data; if it fails, 12A remains screening-only (we do NOT lower the threshold).
k in [5,25) overlaps no 12A sample; all 180 rows go to a SEPARATE CSV so independence is auditable.
n=20 resolves ~0.10/cell; aggregates over D in {4,8} are the meaningful statistics (per-cell diffs not over-read).
S=medium only (S robustness deferred to Phase 13).
length token-exact => L is the only variable across the L axis.

models.desc: additive length term (length harms regardless of D)
models.name: M_B  F(log(1+D), S, L)

models.desc: competition x length interaction (competition more damaging as L grows)
models.name: M_C  F(log(1+D), S, L, log(1+D) x L)

outcomes.A: Long-context penalty REPLICATES: L x D negative and Stage-B passes on fresh n=20 -> 'effective context' thesis confirmed (R = F(task, domain, log(1+D), S, L) with a harmful L interaction).
outcomes.B: Length matters ONLY under competition: D=0 stays flat at long L but D>0 degrades -> large context becomes unreliable only when it contains competing evidence.
outcomes.C: Length barely matters / penalty does NOT replicate -> context COMPOSITION, not length, is the dominant reliability variable; 12A stays screening-only.

target_new.independence: k in [5,25) is disjoint from 12A's k in [0,5); seeds are 500000+k+L, verified collision-free vs 12A and within 12B. answer_word depends only on seed (not D) and length is token-exact, so 12B draws are independent samples from the SAME population as 12A.
target_new.seed_formula: round(pos*1000)*1000 + k + length  (= 500000 + k + L at pos 0.5)

title: long-context penalty CONFIRMATION (independent, preregistered)
